current_model.description: baseline current exact-reuse decision (available at decision time)

metadata_guard.description: current decision plus static explicit metadata compatibility

metadata_guard_or_large.description: metadata guard with scenario footprint > L3 exception

footprint_256k.description: legal candidate and scenario footprint > 256 KiB

notes: In-sample exploratory screen; no held-out benchmark family.
No policy uses post-fusion YMM counts, measured runtimes or final assembly.
Regret is absolute ns above the per-point oracle min(A,B), equal-case weighted.
Confirmed-only metrics exclude high-noise/inconclusive labels from FP/FN and regret.
A 256 KiB or L3 threshold is a scenario rule, not a deployable cost model.
